items.title: Why Amazon Wants the Chips and Blackstone Wants the Buildings
items.summary: Amazon is selling a 75.1% stake in 13 data center shells to Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust for about $5 billion, recycling cash into AI chips amid negative free cash flow and heavy bond issuance.

items.title: Blackstone’s Gray says market shakeout could benefit firm
items.summary: Investing.com -- Blackstone President and Chief Operating Officer Jon Gray said the recent market shakeout could ultimately benefit the private equity giant, arguing that investor negativity has gone too far even as he warned of elevated bubble risks in parts of the market.

items.title: Amazon’s CEO Says Pulling Back on Data Centers Would Be a “Historic Mistake”
items.summary: Andy Jassy defended a spending spree of hundreds of billions to a crowd that had just rejected data centers, yet he left out the one number investors need most. The real threat to Amazon's AI bet may not be demand at all.

items.title: 4 Dividend Stocks That Can Thrive Under a Democratic Congress
items.summary: When Washington stalls, most investors worry about their portfolios. Income seekers have a different play: four payers from four sectors that need no new law to keep raising dividends, including one with a streak nearly half a century long.
